purpose: UCF read-traffic response calibration, not a speed benchmark
verification: entire output equals 0x5a after counters stop
frozen_gate: all group snapshots valid; one raw read-byte event >128MiB and >10*idle; four/one in [2,6]
failure_action: stop UCF model-observation route, no reruns or relaxed gates
limits: does not validate outstanding units, writes, stall attribution or candidate root cause
